newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Suncorp-Metway says home lending rises.
newsitem.headline: Suncorp-Metway says home lending rises.

text.p: The Queensland government-controlled Suncorp-Metway Ltd was experiencing significant growth in home lending with record home loan approvals for the first four months of 1997, chief executive Steve Jones said on Tuesday.
"Approvals for the first four months of this year are up 30 percent compared with the same time last year," Jones told a Property Council of Australia meeting.
"More than 14 percent of this business is coming out of Victoria and New South Wales," Jones said.
Jones said Suncorp-Metway had seen very significant growth in loan approvals since the merger of Metway Bank Ltd, Suncorp and Queensland Industry Development Corp (QIDC) last year.
"Low interest rates are helping a bit but it's a tough market with the mortgage originators hungry for every loan," he said.
"In that environment and given the fact we're in the middle of a merger, it's an outstanding result," Jones said.

He repeated his earlier statements that Suncorp-Metway would be on the sidelines during any potential banking takeover activity because of the Queensland state government's 67 percent stake in the merged group.
